title: Load Bearing People
description: Intercept the fallback order before the Directorate disperses its signing keys.
objective: Intercept transfer receipt at Authoritative record / Intercept transfer receipt at Live mirror
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Your allies can act, but the method will determine who carries the risk.

lore.title: Load Bearing People / Unsent message
lore.text: SABLE / community grid engineer: Intercept the fallback order before the Directorate disperses its signing keys. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Load Bearing People / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Load Bearing People: Your allies can act, but the method will determine who carries the risk. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Load Bearing People / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under shelter-threshold: Your allies can act, but the method will determine who carries the risk. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: Your allies can act, but the method will determine who carries the risk.

choices.title: Act immediately
choices.description: Move before the Directorate can regroup. The conclusion favors reach and accepts disruption.

choices.title: Protect the named people first
choices.description: Use a slower release and preserve specific service routes. The conclusion favors protection over reach.
